purpose: Send gold to a governor's town
note: Issue 368, governor sheet N2. town-economy.md section 4: the Crown can put gold in a town's purse (#400), and the town is richer for it in means, quality of life and patience. The three sums are placeholders for the tuning pass. Placeholder prose.

options.text: on a matter of the town's purse
because {param:town} needs it more than the Treasury does

options.label: a hundred, for what is most wanted
options.text: I am sending a hundred to the town's purse. Spend it on whatever is most wanted; you will know better than I.

options.label: two hundred and fifty, to put the town on its feet
options.text: I am sending two hundred and fifty to the town's purse, to put it on its feet.

options.label: five hundred, and no questions
options.text: I am sending five hundred to the town's purse. I do not want an account of it. I want a town that is glad to be the Crown's.
